losses.counterfactual_contrast: distinguish equivalence-preserving maps from incentive-changing maps
losses.equilibrium: set-exact matching or regret-weighted loss on checked matrix games
losses.numeric_transformation: smooth regression to checked post-transform output and delta
losses.operand_sign_exponent_mantissa: existing v3 supervision on X and Y where defined
losses.paired_consistency: both orientations must independently predict the SAME canonical target
losses.structural_fields: structured categorical/sequence objective on actors, actions, conditions, and invariants

mathematical_state: G=(N,S,A,T,O,I,U,H); physically realizable state/action constraints precede strategic analysis

mix_policy.composition: explicit fixed per-family distribution; never transition by training step

model_initialization: Continue current frozen Qwen + numeric X/Y attention head checkpoint; new structured multi-field targets require a separately trainable transformation head/adapter.

scheduling.strategy: explicit user-selected distribution, not step milestones

scope: game as unit: math/structural equivalence, changed-games counterfactuals, Captain scenario and tactical games

capture: canonical operands X,Y for existing numerical head
full structured game transform for additional head
execute: actual transformed payoff tensor / numeric output
transfer: same underlying game under new story
different games with same math structure
